claim: Always proxy API key and token requests through a secure backend. Never expose credentials in client-side applications.
quote: Always proxy API key and token requests through a secure backend. Never expose credentials in client-side applications.

claim: Requests go to the production server https://gf-api.aws.glofox.com/prod followed by a versioned path such as /v3.0/locations/retrieve ...
quote: https://gf-api.aws.glofox.com/prod /v3.0/locations/retrieve

claim: ... or /2.0/branches/{id}.
quote: https://gf-api.aws.glofox.com/prod /2.0/branches/{id}

claim: Glofox defines a branch, also called a studio or location, as a physical location with its own set of members and staff.
quote: A branch (a.k.a. studio or location) is a physical location. They will have their own set of members and staff (even roaming ones can be shared).

claim: POST /v3.0/locations/retrieve returns the branches in your integration's allowed namespaces, all of them if you pass no filter, and Glofox says it filters access by the integrator's configured permissions.
quote: Retrieves locations (branches) associated with an integrator's allowed namespaces. Acts as a proxy to the core Glofox API, filtering access based on the integrator's configured permissions. If no namespaces are provided in the request body, all locations from the integrator's assigned namespaces are returned.

claim: Member search works across a whole namespace taken from the branch in your x-glofox-branch-id header, and the same email or phone can return more than one member when it exists at several locations.
quote: Searches for users (members) across an entire namespace by email address, phone number, or both. The namespace is determined by the branch in the x-glofox-branch-id header.

claim: The same email or phone can return more than one member when it exists at several locations.
quote: More than one user may be returned when the same email or phone exists at multiple locations in the namespace.

claim: Phone search is an exact match on the member's normalized E.164 number and excludes staff.
quote: Phone matching is an exact match against the member's normalized E.164 phone; members without a normalized phone are not returned. Phone searches return users of type MEMBER only (including leads and cancelled members). Staff are excluded from phone searches.

claim: 429 when the API blocks the request when you exceed the rate limit.
quote: 429 Too Many Requests The API blocks the request when you exceed the rate limit.

claim: 500 for server-side problems.
